node: Specialty enclosures, cabinets, fixtures, displays, and availability-driven components for stores, warehouses, and job sites
summary: Expanded the node through an underfollowed discovery lens. The clearest reference anchor is nVent for electrical enclosures and cabinets, but the more Serenity-relevant small/mid-cap lane is LSI Industries for retail fixtures/displays, Distribution Solutions Group for high-touch MRO/OEM supply-chain availability, and Park-Ohio for outsourced small-component inventory management. The main chokepoint hypothesis is not proprietary product IP; it is catalog breadth, stocked availability, vendor-managed inventory, engineering/application support, and embedded customer workflows that reduce downtime or remodel/buildout delays.
